name: Paygent Connect
does: Usage-based billing/metering platform for AI products: instruments LLM/agent/voice usage and turns it into customers, orders, invoices, wallets and Stripe payment links.
auth_detail: API key from dashboard, e.g. paygent_sdk.init(api_key='your-paygent-api-key'); no OAuth anywhere in docs; payments collected via Stripe payment links, not NMI.
gate_detail: Official quick start: 'Sign up at withpaygent.com and get your API key from the dashboard.' Small early-stage company (sparse web presence).
breadth: Billing core: Customers, Orders & Invoicing, Agents, Prepaid Wallets, Postpaid Wallets, Voice Tracking, plus Python/Node/Go SDKs, LangChain/LangGraph/LiveKit/Vapi integrations.
blocker: Identity mismatch: brief describes an 'NMI-powered payment gateway wrapper' called Paygent Connect, but official docs (docs.withpaygent.com) describe only an AI-billing platform with Stripe payment links - no 'Connect' product and no NMI mention verifiable (paygent.co.jp is an unrelated Japanese gateway)
notes: Fetched official docs live. The 'NMI-powered' hint could not be confirmed from any official Paygent source; if the toolkit truly targets NMI gateway credentials, access would be partner/processor-gated instead. Docs site is Mintlify with .md and MCP endpoints for AI agents.

name: iPayX
does: FINTRAC-registered FX forensic-audit layer: API + MCP server that compare bank/card FX rates to live mid-market and score hidden markup on transactions.
auth_detail: Bearer token on POST https://api.ipayx.ai/functions/v1/fx-audit-engine (per official llms.txt: 'Auth: Bearer token').
gate_detail: Official pricing: 'Forensic Pack from $297, API plans from $99/mo' - buy plan, get API token.
breadth: Narrow/niche: one core fx-audit-engine endpoint plus audit tools (spread calc, FX scoring, forensic report, hash verification); OpenAPI 3.1 published at /.well-known/openapi.json.
notes: Site is a React SPA; official llms.txt (linked from the site's ai-content meta tag) provided the full API/MCP picture. MCP endpoint mcp.ipayx.ai/mcp (Streamable HTTP).

name: PitchBook
does: Private-markets research data API (Direct Data): on-demand REST access to companies, deals, investors, funds, people, LPs and service providers.
auth_detail: Official help: 'Our team will work with you ... establish the API connection through an API key or authentication token'; base URL https://api.pitchbook.com; third-party docs show an 'Authorization: PB-Token <key>' header.
gate_detail: 'To start your API connection, you will need to send a request directly to our Direct Data team' (or via Plugins & Apps section of the PitchBook platform for existing clients). No self-serve, no trial for the API itself.
breadth: Broad data coverage (many relational endpoints incl. financing details, deal stock info, VC exit predictor), but access-gated; official endpoint docs shared privately (a published Postman collection exists).
blocker: No self-serve credentials: API access requires going through PitchBook's Direct Data sales/enterprise process; no MCP and no public sandbox.
notes: Official help page fetched live (pitchbook.com blocks some bots; curl with browser UA worked). Auth header format (PB-Token) from dltHub/Frontegg third-party docs since PitchBook's own endpoint docs sit behind the sales process.

name: NotebookLM
does: Enterprise notebook API (Gemini Notebook Enterprise, formerly NotebookLM Enterprise) on Google Cloud: create/manage notebooks, sources, sharing and audio-overview generation via Discovery Engine endpoints.
auth_detail: All examples use 'Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth print-access-token)' - Google-issued OAuth2 bearer tokens; no API-key option.
gate_detail: Requires Gemini Notebook Enterprise admin setup and licenses; sharing needs the Cloud NotebookLM User IAM role. Not available to consumer NotebookLM users.
breadth: Limited: v1alpha (pre-GA) REST on {location}-discoveryengine.googleapis.com covering notebooks.create/get/listRecentlyViewed/batchDelete/share plus source and audio-overview pages; no GraphQL.
blocker: Enterprise-only: needs Gemini Enterprise licensing + admin provisioning, and the API is v1alpha pre-GA with a narrow operation set.
notes: Fetched official Google Cloud docs live. Product rebranded under Gemini Enterprise ('Gemini Notebook Enterprise'); API is served through Discovery Engine, not a standalone NotebookLM API.

name: Otter AI
does: AI meeting notetaker whose official Otter MCP Server exposes meeting transcripts, cross-meeting search and insights to Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity and other AI clients.
auth_detail: Official help article: 'All access is OAuth-authenticated with granular permissions. Your AI assistant can only access meetings you explicitly authorize'; connect via Claude/ChatGPT connector directories.
gate_detail: Any Otter account can connect from the Claude/ChatGPT connector directories; workspace admins can pre-provision the connector for orgs. Plan restrictions for MCP are not stated.
breadth: MCP-only agent surface (search transcripts, analyze patterns, generate content from meeting data); no documented public REST API.
notes: Fetched the official Zendesk help article live (via Zendesk Help Center API). Vendor-hosted MCP, no local install. MCP setup covers Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Perplexity.

name: Fathom
does: AI meeting recorder with a REST API for meetings/transcripts/recording artifacts (plus webhooks, TS/Python SDKs, OAuth for public apps) and official MCP connectors for Claude and ChatGPT.
auth_detail: 'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' header against https://api.fathom.ai/external/v1; keys generated in User Settings > API Access and scoped to the creator's meetings; separate OAuth flow for public integrations.
gate_detail: 'Head to the API Access section of your User Settings and generate an API key' - self-serve from any account; keys can only access your own/shared meetings.
breadth: Broad for its domain: list/search meetings, fetch transcripts, recording artifacts, webhooks, SDKs (TypeScript/Python), OAuth apps.
notes: Developer portal (developers.fathom.ai) fetched live. Docs are Mintlify-hosted with llms.txt; MCP docs section is first-class alongside REST and OAuth docs.

name: Consensus
does: Academic search API over 400M+ peer-reviewed papers: query returns ranked papers with titles, authors, journals, citation counts, DOIs and optional full-text excerpts.
auth_detail: 'Pass the key in the x-api-key header. Requests without a valid key return 401.' Keys created in Consensus under profile > 'API & MCP Dashboard' > Keys and clients. (Brief hint said OAuth, but current official docs use API keys.)
gate_detail: 'The API is self-serve on every Consensus plan' - Free includes 30 calls/mo, Pro 500, Teams 2,000, Enterprise custom; rate limit 1 req/s on lower tiers.
breadth: Narrow but deep: one main REST endpoint (GET https://api.consensus.app/v1/search) with pagination/full-text options plus a legacy variant.
notes: Fetched official docs live. MCP is explicitly bundled with the API dashboard (mcp.consensus.app/mcp; Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor/VS Code setup guides).

name: Reducto
does: Document-parsing API: converts PDFs, images, spreadsheets, slides and forms (30+ file types) into structured, LLM-ready JSON with parse/classify/extract/split/edit endpoints and pipelines.
auth_detail: Bearer token: '-H "Authorization: Bearer $REDUCTO_API_KEY"'; key created in Reducto Studio (sidebar > API Keys > Create API Key).
gate_detail: 'Go to studio.reducto.ai and sign up for a free account', then create an API key in the Studio sidebar - free signup, paid usage tiers.
breadth: Broad document-AI surface: Parse, Classify, Extract, Split, Edit, Pipelines; SDKs in Python/Node.js/Go + REST + a Reducto CLI for local files.
notes: Official Mintlify docs fetched live as markdown. Quickstart is explicitly agent-first ('Fastest path for coding agents': CLI, MCP, or SDK). Hosted MCP at mcp.reducto.ai/mcp.

name: Devin
does: Autonomous AI software engineer (Cognition) with a documented REST API and an official Devin MCP server (mcp.devin.ai) letting external AI tools create/manage Devin sessions, playbooks, knowledge and schedules.
auth_detail: Devin API key from account settings; token types are cog_-prefixed org-scoped/enterprise service-user keys; 'The MCP server supports the same authentication methods as the Devin API.'
gate_detail: 'Sign up for a Devin account at Devin.ai' and 'Generate an API key from your account settings' - self-serve signup, but Devin is a paid/usage-based (ACU) product; API access included with the account.
breadth: Broad: large api-reference section (302 API pages in llms index, v2/v3 endpoints incl. sessions, knowledge, service-user API keys) plus MCP and DeepWiki MCP.
notes: Official docs fetched live as markdown. MCP server is authenticated and first-party; covers session management, playbooks, knowledge, scheduling.

name: higgsfield
does: Generative-media API platform (Soul image gen, Genjutsu motion transfer, Kling, Seedance, etc.): submit a request to a model endpoint, then poll or receive a webhook for results.
auth_detail: Key ID + secret pair: 'Authorization: Key YOUR_KEY_ID:YOUR_KEY_SECRET' (legacy hf-api-key/hf-secret headers also accepted); credentials created in Higgsfield Console (console.higgsfield.ai); server-side only.
gate_detail: Self-serve API platform at open.higgsfield.ai (dashboard with API keys, playground, billing, per-second usage pricing e.g. 'from $0.144/s'); free trial not confirmed in docs.
breadth: Model catalog of image/video endpoints with shared auth/polling/webhook/upload docs; official Python + TypeScript SDKs; no CLI found in official docs despite the brief hint (higgsfield.ai/cli).
notes: Official docs and open platform fetched live. No MCP server mentioned in official docs (community wrappers may exist). Asynchronous job pattern (request_id/status_url/cancel_url/webhooks).

name: Mermaid CLI
does: Local open-source CLI (mmdc, @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli) that renders Mermaid diagram definitions to SVG/PNG/PDF via bundled Chromium/Puppeteer; also exposes a Node run() function.
auth_detail: Fully local npm-installable tool (npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli, Docker image minlag/mermaid-cli); no accounts, keys or network service involved.
gate_detail: Nothing to gate: MIT-licensed tool installed from npm/Docker. Note: local tool, not an API.
breadth: Local tool, not an API - renders single .mmd files or Markdown code blocks; a Node API exists but is explicitly not covered by semver.
notes: GitHub README fetched live. It is a local rendering tool (useful to ship inside an integration's runtime, e.g. pre-rendering diagrams), but there is no hosted API to authenticate against or integrate with.

name: YouTube Transcript
does: Hosted YouTube data API (transcriptapi.com): transcripts (with/without timestamps), YouTube search, channel search, playlists and metadata via REST, billed per-credit, with an official YouTube MCP and agent skills.
gate_detail: 'Get Started Free' signup with credit-based pricing (e.g. 1 credit per transcript/search); signup/login pages live; production users cited at ~11M transcripts/mo.
breadth: YouTube-only: transcript, search, channel search, channel/video endpoints; every feature 'works via API, MCP, and agent skills'. No GraphQL, no multi-platform.
notes: Site is a React SPA with prerendering; fetched the prerendered homepage (Googlebot UA) which contains the full API reference with curl examples, auth header, credit costs and MCP/agent-skill docs.

name: Grain
does: AI meeting recorder/conversation-intelligence platform with a public REST API v2 (recordings, transcripts, highlights, uploads, webhooks) and an official Grain MCP server for AI clients.
auth_detail: 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' plus required 'Public-Api-Version' header; three token types: Personal Access Token, Workspace Access Token, and OAuth2 Authorization Code (with PKCE) tokens.
gate_detail: PATs/WATs 'Generated manually from the integrations page' (grain.com/app/settings/integrations?tab=api) - self-serve; note 'The workspace scope is not available on all plans' (Workspace API is on the Business plan).
breadth: Broad for its domain: full endpoint reference (recordings, highlights, uploads, webhooks), versioned API (2025-10-31 / 2026-10-01), rate-limit docs, official MCP docs.
notes: Developer hub at developers.grain.com fetched live (docs.grain.com and grain.com/developers do not exist). OAuth2 flow fully documented alongside PAT/WAT tokens.
